definitions.rationale: Expands the named solutionBody helper to the translated function-body constructor tree, so it is a structural definition rather than an execution rule or an additional mathematical fact.
definitions.text:
rule solutionBody =>
    Return(
      IfExp(
        Compare(Name("text"), CmpOp("==", Str(""))),
        NoneVal,
        Call(
          Attribute(
            Call(
              Attribute(Name("hashlib"), "md5"),
              Call(Attribute(Name("text"), "encode"), )),
            "hexdigest"),
          )))
    .Stmts

definitions.rationale: Expands the named solutionProgram helper to the module constructor tree containing the import and target function, making it a macro-style structural definition.
definitions.text:
rule solutionProgram =>
    Module(
      Import("hashlib")
      FuncDef("string_to_md5", Params("text"), solutionBody))
